title: Extinct Media Museum Tokyo
summary: This is a Hacker News submission about the Extinct Media Museum located in Tokyo's Otemachi district, which appears to be a museum dedicated to preserving and displaying obsolete media formats and technologies that have been replaced by modern digital alternatives.
problem_solved: It preserves and educates about obsolete media technologies and formats that would otherwise be forgotten as digital technology advances.
why_valuable: It serves as a cultural archive of technological history, helping people understand and appreciate the evolution of media from physical formats to digital.
